content:
The format of events that OpenSearch Service sends to Amazon EventBridge and Amazon
CloudWatch has changed, speciﬁcally the detail-type ﬁeld. The source ﬁeld (aws.es) remains
the same. For the complete format for each event type, see the section called “Monitoring events”.
If you have existing event rules that depend on the old format, make sure to update them to
conform to the new format.
